about: Source list of the FM stations of Lomé, Togo. Edited by hand. 'stream' is the station's own internet stream; it is left empty when no direct address was found (scripts/discover.py suggests candidates from Radio Browser). 'backup_streams' are other addresses of the same station. 'permission' is asked, granted, refused or not-asked: see AGREEMENTS.md. A null frequency is still to confirm. 'sources' are the pages where the frequency and the stream address were read. 'verified' is unverified, heard (someone heard it play in a browser with tools/listen.html) or checked (scripts/check.py found it live): every address here was copied from web pages on 15 November 2026 and none has been played or checked yet. 'note' says what is doubtful.

stations.name: Sport FM
stations.note: Frequency read only in the station's name on two directories (15 Nov 2026). Address from one directory page (surfmusic.de); the station's own site could not be opened. Format assumed from the name.

stations.name: Zéphyr FM
stations.note: Address from one directory page (surfmusic.de) on 15 Nov 2026; it goes through a hosting proxy and may be old: two other directories (streema, tuningaradio) mark the station's stream as offline. The station's own site shows no stream address and no frequency. Another page (bamwor.com) gives 93.0 MHz.

stations.name: Taxi FM
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026: one directory only gives a signed, expiring proxy link, and lists an unrelated radionomy address as the homepage. No website found, only a Facebook page. Frequency from one directory (streema).

stations.name: Kanal FM
stations.note: Address read on the station's own site on 15 Nov 2026, as the 'flux' parameter of its player link. The site does not state the frequency: it comes from one directory (streema).

stations.name: Light Radio
stations.note: Address and frequency read on the station's own site and on one directory on 15 Nov 2026; both agree.

stations.name: Nana FM
stations.note: Frequency from the station's own site. Address from one directory page only (15 Nov 2026), kept exactly as shown, with its query string (a player parameter, not a listener id); the host is a rented server name and may change. The station's own pages show no address. Many programmes have Ewe titles: the main language was not confirmed. Another page (bamwor.com) gives 102.5 MHz.

stations.name: Victoire FM
stations.note: No usable direct address found on 15 Nov 2026. The station streams through Zeno (player page https://zeno.fm/player/victoire-fm); the only audio address shown by a directory carries a signed token that expires after about a minute, so it is not recorded. Frequency from the station's own site. Zeno lists French and Ewe.

stations.name: Radio Maria Togo
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026: one directory only gives a signed, expiring proxy link (stream host dreamsiteradiocp.com, 64 kbps AAC). The station's own site could not be opened. Frequency from one directory (streema).

stations.name: Radio Lomé
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026. The public station's own site only links a Zeno player page (https://www.zeno.fm/player/radiolome). Frequency from three directories (streema, onlineradiobox, tuningaradio); the station's site does not state it, and another page (bamwor.com) gives 97.5 MHz.

stations.name: Radio Carré Jeunes (RCJ)
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026. Frequency, city and homepage rest on one directory page (tuningaradio); the station's own site could not be opened. Format not researched.

stations.name: Hit Radio Togo
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026. Local station of the Moroccan Hit Radio network; the homepage is the network's site. Frequency from one directory (streema).

stations.name: Pyramide FM
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026. The station streams through Zeno (page https://zeno.fm/radio/emcradio/, 'PYRAMIDE FM LOME'), which shows no audio address. The homepage comes from one directory and could not be opened. Frequency from two directories.

stations.name: Radio Gloire à Dieu
stations.note: No direct stream address found on 15 Nov 2026; the one directory that lists the station marks its stream as unavailable. No website found, only a Facebook page. Frequency from that one directory (streema).
